request.description: Creates a new assessment draft. Status defaults to DRAFT.
Get detailed assessment with full question set, rubrics, and answer keys.
Attach a problem from the problem bank to the assessment draft.
Transition assessment status: DRAFT -> PUBLISHED -> ACTIVE -> CLOSED -> ARCHIVED.
Removes a problem from an assessment draft.
Dispatches invitations to candidates. Auto-saves {{invitationToken}} to environment.
Lists all candidate invitations sent for this assessment.
Candidate verifies their invite token. Logged-in session email must match the invitation recipient!
Validates inviteToken against logged-in candidate, initializes server countdown timer, and returns sanitized questions. Auto-saves {{attemptId}}.

exec: console.log("Saved first problemId from attempt:", res.data.problems[0].problemId);

request.description: Fetches active attempt state, remaining countdown seconds, and previously saved answer drafts.
Autosaves an answer draft for an MCQ question during the exam.
Autosaves coding or essay answers.
Final submission. Locks answers, performs immediate MCQ auto-grading, and routes subjective problems to the Evaluation Queue.
Lists submissions pending human review. Auto-saves first {{reviewId}}.
Get candidate answers, rubrics, and existing scores. Auto-saves first subjective {{submissionAnswerId}}.
Assigns the review to the current recruiter/admin, preventing concurrent review collisions.
Awards marks and constructive feedback against rubric.
Finalizes evaluation review, aggregates auto and manual points, computes percentage & pass/fail status, and marks attempt as COMPLETED.
Aggregated cohort statistics: pass rates, average/median scores, distribution buckets, and problem-by-problem accuracy.
Detailed recruiter scorecard showing breakdown per question, reviewer marks, rubrics, and feedback.
Candidate view of all completed attempts and scores (no organization header required).
